title: The $abc$ Conjecture Revisited
summary: We propose a new abc-type conjecture. We motivate the conjecture and illustrate its relevance through several applications. Our main result concerns the function $$ W(x,y) := \sum_{j = 1}^{y}ω(x+j) \quad (y \in \mathbb{N},\ x \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}) $$ where $ω(n)$ denotes the number of distinct prime divisors of $n$. The new conjecture implies that, for each fixed $y \in \mathbb{N}$, $$ \limsup_{x \to \infty} \frac{W(x,y)\log\log x}{\log x} = 1. $$
